newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia skilled vacancies index down in May.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia skilled vacancies index down in May.

text.p: The Australian government's skilled vacancies index fell 1.4 percent in May from April and was 0.7 percent lower than a year earlier, the Employment Department said on Thursday.
The index fell to 145.0 in May, the second consecutive monthly fall. It was 119.7 percent above the recession low of 66 in mid-1991, the department said.
Three of the 16 occupational groups recorded an increase, led by a 4.2 percent rise in building trades.
The biggest falls in the 11 groups recording a decrease were 9.4 percent in electrical and electronics trades and 6.0 percent in metal trades. Two groups were unchanged.
Queensland was the only state to record an increase, up 2.4 percent. South Australia remained steady and all other states fell, led by an 8.4 percent drop in the Northern Territory.
The monthly index is based on a count of skilled vacancies advertisements in the major metropolitan newspaper for each state and the Northern Territory.
